rule.title: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise

summary.allegation: The cardholder says the Carlton armchair delivered on 18 April 2025 has a structural fault, with a wobbling frame and a leg that is not properly seated, that it is not fit for purpose, and that the merchant has not answered their refund request.
summary.to_defend: Visa requires the published description of the item, evidence that what was delivered matches that description, and evidence either that a return or refund route was offered and not used or that the cardholder kept using the goods after complaining.

requirements.title: Published item description
requirements.text: The merchant's published description of the item the cardholder purchased.
requirements.finding: The merchant supplied a product page snapshot generated on the transaction date for the Carlton Mid-Century Armchair at GBP 329.00, matching the disputed amount, and it sets out frame, legs, upholstery and dimensions.

citations.quote:
The Carlton armchair combines a hand-finished beech frame with deep-buttoned
sage velvet upholstery. Tapered solid oak legs. Seat height 46cm.

Product: Carlton Mid-Century Armchair, Sage Velvet
Price: £329.00
SKU: HH-ARM-CARL-SG

requirements.title: Delivered item matches description
requirements.text: Evidence the item delivered matches that description (photos, specs, serial number match).
requirements.finding: A single driver photo shows a sage armchair with dark wooden legs delivered on 18 April 2025, which is consistent with the listed colour and style, but it is a straight-on front view with no sides, underside or leg detail, carries no order number or serial reference, and cannot show whether the frame or leg seating was sound at handover.
requirements.gap: No condition evidence of the frame or legs, no serial or order reference tying the photographed unit to this order, and no pre-despatch quality check record addressing the alleged structural fault.

citations.quote:
Carlton Armchair (Sage) — delivered 18 Apr 2025
Photo taken by driver at delivery (front view only)

requirements.title: Return route offered and unused
requirements.text: Evidence the merchant offered a return/refund route and the cardholder did not use it, OR evidence the cardholder used and retained the merchandise after raising the complaint.
requirements.finding: Only a generic returns policy page was supplied; there is no record that a return, collection or refund was offered to this cardholder for this order, no record of the cardholder declining it, and no evidence the cardholder continued to use and keep the chair after complaining.
requirements.gap: No case or email record showing the merchant's response to the refund request, no collection offer for order SKU HH-ARM-CARL-SG delivered 18 April 2025, and no evidence of continued use or retention.

documents.label: General returns policy page
documents.reason: A published policy last updated January 2025; it records no event for this order and does not show a return route was offered to or declined by this cardholder.

alerts.text: The cardholder states the merchant did not respond to their refund request and nothing in D1 to D3 answers that; obtain the customer service or returns ticket history for this order before filing.
Evidence for R2 was read from an image. Check the highlight.

reasons: Key evidence read from an image
Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

checks.label: Key evidence comes from document text, not only from an image
Images the evidence relies on are fully legible
Every quoted passage was found in the documents
The disputed charge matches the merchant's own records
The rule check and the AI recommendation agree

justification: R3 is unevidenced, as only a generic returns policy was supplied with no record of a return or refund route offered to this cardholder or of continued use, and R2 is only partial; the merchant could plausibly close both gaps.
rationale: The cardholder alleges the Carlton Mid-Century Armchair delivered on 18 April 2025 has a structural frame and leg fault and that no refund response was given.
merchant_requests: Full email and ticket correspondence with the cardholder for this order from 18 April 2025 to 8 May 2025, showing the refund request and HavenHome's response.
Any record of a free collection, repair, replacement or refund offer made to this cardholder under the defective items policy, with dates and the order number.
Pre-despatch quality control or assembly inspection record for SKU HH-ARM-CARL-SG for the unit shipped on this order, including any serial or batch number.
Additional delivery-day photographs showing the armchair's legs, underside and rear, or the signed proof of delivery naming the recipient and the BS8 1TR address.
Any evidence the cardholder continued to use or retained the armchair after raising the complaint, such as later correspondence or a declined collection slot.
analyst_notes: Confirm a single GBP 329.00 charge on 15 April 2025 and that no partial refund or goodwill credit has already been issued.
TXN shows AVS Y, CVV M and 3DS authenticated, which is useful context but does not address a not as described claim.
